<style>
/* =========================================================
   HUBSPOT FORMS (developer embed) - SITE-WIDE
   ========================================================= */

/* ----- HubSpot CSS variables ----- */
.hs-form-html,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-Renderer {
    /* Global */
    --hsf-global__font-family: Lexend, sans-serif;
    --hsf-global__font-size: 14px;
    --hsf-global__color: #333333;
    --hsf-global-error__color: #e5484d;

    /* Spacing */
    --hsf-row__horizontal-spacing: 8px;
    --hsf-row__vertical-spacing: 8px;
    --hsf-module__vertical-spacing: 4px;

    /* Container */
    --hsf-background__background-color: transparent;
    --hsf-background__padding: 0;
    --hsf-background__border-style: none;
    --hsf-background__border-radius: 0;

    /* Labels (hidden for text fields, used for checkbox) */
    --hsf-field-label__font-family: Lexend, sans-serif;
    --hsf-field-label__font-size: 12px;
    --hsf-field-label__color: #000000;
    --hsf-field-label-requiredindicator__color: #000000;

    /* Inputs */
    --hsf-field-input__font-family: Lexend, sans-serif;
    --hsf-field-input__color: #333333;
    --hsf-field-input__background-color: #ffffff;
    --hsf-field-input__placeholder-color: #757575;
    --hsf-field-input__border-color: #E2E8EB;
    --hsf-field-input__border-width: 1px;
    --hsf-field-input__border-style: solid;
    --hsf-field-input__border-radius: 8px;
    --hsf-field-input__padding: 0 10px;

    /* Textarea */
    --hsf-field-textarea__font-family: Lexend, sans-serif;
    --hsf-field-textarea__color: #333333;
    --hsf-field-textarea__background-color: #ffffff;
    --hsf-field-textarea__placeholder-color: #757575;
    --hsf-field-textarea__border-color: #E2E8EB;
    --hsf-field-textarea__border-width: 1px;
    --hsf-field-textarea__border-style: solid;
    --hsf-field-textarea__border-radius: 8px;
    --hsf-field-textarea__padding: 10px;

    /* Checkbox / radio */
    --hsf-field-checkbox__background-color: #ffffff;
    --hsf-field-checkbox__color: #015fff;
    --hsf-field-checkbox__border-color: #E2E8EB;
    --hsf-field-checkbox__border-width: 1px;
    --hsf-field-checkbox__border-style: solid;
    --hsf-field-radio__background-color: #ffffff;
    --hsf-field-radio__color: #015fff;
    --hsf-field-radio__border-color: #E2E8EB;
    --hsf-field-radio__border-width: 1px;
    --hsf-field-radio__border-style: solid;

    /* Rich text (consent / privacy copy) */
    --hsf-richtext__font-family: Lexend, sans-serif;
    --hsf-richtext__font-size: 10px;
    --hsf-richtext__color: #000000;

    /* Button */
    --hsf-button__font-family: Lexend, sans-serif;
    --hsf-button__font-size: 14px;
    --hsf-button__color: #ffffff;
    --hsf-button__background-color: #015fff;
    --hsf-button__background-image: none;
    --hsf-button__border-radius: 6px;
    --hsf-button__padding: 0 10px;
    --hsf-button__box-shadow: none;
    --hsf-button__width: 100%;

    /* Alerts */
    --hsf-erroralert__font-family: Lexend, sans-serif;
    --hsf-erroralert__font-size: 12px;
    --hsf-erroralert__color: #e5484d;
    --hsf-infoalert__font-family: Lexend, sans-serif;
    --hsf-infoalert__font-size: 12px;
    --hsf-infoalert__color: #333333;
}

/* ----- Container ----- */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-Form {
    font-family: Lexend, sans-serif !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    padding-bottom: 10px !important;
}

/* ----- Hide empty labels on text/email/select/textarea fields ----- */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-TextField > .hsfc-FieldLabel,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-EmailField > .hsfc-FieldLabel,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-PhoneField > .hsfc-FieldLabel,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-NumberField > .hsfc-FieldLabel,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-DropdownField > .hsfc-FieldLabel,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-TextareaField > .hsfc-FieldLabel {
    display: none !important;
}

/* ----- Inputs ----- */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-TextInput,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-DropdownInput,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-PhoneInput,
.hs-form-html select {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 36px !important;
    min-height: 36px !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 10px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    font-family: Lexend, sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0 !important;
    line-height: 18px !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-TextareaInput,
.hs-form-html textarea {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 60px !important;
    min-height: 60px !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 10px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    font-family: Lexend, sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    line-height: 18px !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-TextInput::placeholder,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-TextareaInput::placeholder {
    color: #757575 !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-TextInput:focus,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-TextInput:focus-visible,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-TextareaInput:focus,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-TextareaInput:focus-visible,
.hs-form-html select:focus-visible {
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* ----- Row spacing (8px between fields, like request-demo) ----- */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-Row {
    margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}

/* ----- First Name + Last Name side by side ----- */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-Step__Content > .hsfc-Row:has(input[name="0-1/firstname"]),
.hs-form-html .hsfc-Step__Content > .hsfc-Row:has(input[name="0-1/lastname"]) {
    display: inline-grid !important;
    width: calc(50% - 4px) !important;
    vertical-align: top !important;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-Step__Content > .hsfc-Row:has(input[name="0-1/firstname"]) {
    margin-right: 8px !important;
}

/* ----- Consent / privacy block ----- */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-DataPrivacyField .hsfc-Row {
    margin-bottom: 4px !important;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-RichText,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-RichText p,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-RichText span {
    font-family: Lexend, sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 10px !important;
    line-height: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    color: #000 !important;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-RichText p {
    margin: 0 !important;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-RichText a,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-RichText a u {
    color: #64b5d6 !important;
    text-decoration: underline !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

/* ----- Format consent copy for checkbox ----- */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-DataPrivacyField .hsfc-Row:has(> .hsfc-RichText):has(~ .hsfc-Row > .hsfc-CheckboxField) {
    display: none !important;
}

/* Checkbox rows */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-CheckboxField .hsfc-FieldLabel,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-CheckboxFieldGroup .hsfc-FieldLabel {
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: flex-start !important;
    gap: 8px !important;
    font-family: Lexend, sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 12px !important;
    line-height: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    color: #000 !important;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-CheckboxField .hsfc-FieldLabel span,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-CheckboxFieldGroup .hsfc-FieldLabel span {
    font-family: Lexend, sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 12px !important;
    line-height: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-CheckboxInput {
    flex: 0 0 14px !important;
    width: 14px !important;
    min-width: 14px !important;
    max-width: 14px !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    height: 14px !important;
    margin: 1px 0 0 0 !important;
    border-radius: 3px !important;
}

/* Radio rows */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-RadioFieldGroup .hsfc-FieldLabel {
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    gap: 8px !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 18px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    color: #000 !important;
}

/* ----- Submit button ----- */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-NavigationRow {
    margin-top: 12px !important;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-NavigationRow__Buttons {
    display: block !important;
    width: 100% !important;
}

.hs-form-html .hsfc-Button,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-Button:hover,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-Button:focus,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-Button:active {
    display: block !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    height: 36px !important;
    padding: 0 10px !important;
    border: 0 !important;
    border-radius: 6px !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    outline: none !important;
    background: #015fff !important;
    background-color: #015fff !important;
    background-image: none !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    font-family: Lexend, sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    line-height: 36px !important;
    -webkit-appearance: none !important;
    appearance: none !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
}

/* ----- Errors ----- */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-ErrorAlert {
    font-family: Lexend, sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 12px !important;
    margin-top: 4px !important;
}

/* ----- Mobile: stack First/Last ----- */
@media only screen and (max-width: 480px) {
    .hs-form-html .hsfc-Step__Content > .hsfc-Row:has(input[name="0-1/firstname"]),
    .hs-form-html .hsfc-Step__Content > .hsfc-Row:has(input[name="0-1/lastname"]) {
        display: flex !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        margin-right: 0 !important;
    }
}

/* ----- reCAPTCHA badge ----- */
.hs-form-html .hsfc-ReCaptchaV3,
.hs-form-html .hsfc-ReCaptchaV3__Badge__Container,
.grecaptcha-badge {
    visibility: hidden !important;
    height: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;

<script>

  document.querySelectorAll(".tab-text-link").forEach(link => {

    link.style.cursor = "pointer";

    link.addEventListener("click", function(e) {

      // Stop Webflow tab behavior completely
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      e.stopImmediatePropagation();

      const url = this.getAttribute("data-url");

      if (url) {
        window.location.href = url;
      }

    });

  });

});
</script>

<script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".tab-underscore-link");

  tabs.forEach(tab => {

    tab.addEventListener("click", function () {

      // Remove active class from all tabs
      tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove("is-active"));

      // Add active class to clicked tab
      this.classList.add("is-active");

    });

  });

});

</script><script>
  const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.video-element_graphic-element.is1, .video-element_graphic-element.is2, .video-element_graphic-element.is3, .video-element_graphic-element.is4');

  // Assign random movement intensities to each element
  const elementData = Array.from(elements).map((el) => ({
    el,
    xIntensity: (Math.random() * 10 + 4) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),
    yIntensity: (Math.random() * 10 + 4) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),
    rotIntensity: (Math.random() * 1 + 0.3) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),
    currentX: 0,
    currentY: 0,
    currentRot: 0,
    targetX: 0,
    targetY: 0,
    targetRot: 0
  }));

  let mouseX = 0.5;
  let mouseY = 0.5;

  window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    mouseX = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
    mouseY = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 - 1;
  });

  function animate() {
    elementData.forEach((data) => {
      data.targetX = mouseX * data.xIntensity;
      data.targetY = mouseY * data.yIntensity;
      data.targetRot = mouseX * data.rotIntensity;

      data.currentX += (data.targetX - data.currentX) * 0.06;
      data.currentY += (data.targetY - data.currentY) * 0.06;
      data.currentRot += (data.targetRot - data.currentRot) * 0.06;

      data.el.style.transform = `translate3d(${data.currentX}px, ${data.currentY}px, 0) rotate(${data.currentRot}deg)`;
    });

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  animate();
</script>
